metadata.agent_last_message:
I'll skip cleaning the `target` directory to avoid any non-interactive mode confirmation issues.I have implemented the G-code simulator in Rust as a standard Cargo project in the `output/` directory. The simulator follows the RS274NGC specification and the provided clarifications, supporting modal groups, coordinate systems, tool offsets, circular arcs in all planes, canned cycles (G81-G89), and probing (G38.2). It produces the required JSON output for both the final machine state and a detailed execution trace with delta-based entries and configurable sampling. The implementation uses only the Rust standard library and adheres to all specified technical constraints.

```bash
cargo build --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml
cargo run --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml -- --input <gcode_file> --output <result_file>
```
